Maya (People Ops): @here Quick reminder — SOC2 + Annual Privacy attestation and mandatory privacy training are due Fri May 24 EOD PT. Please finish the training (https://redwood.learn/privacy-2024) and upload any role-based evidence to the Compliance Drive (https://drive.redwood.com/compliance). We need: training cert (everyone), access review snapshots (admins/infra), vendor contracts (product). Ping me with blockers. :megaphone:
Samir (Eng-Security): Does this apply to infra-only contractors? Which specific evidence should infra gather?
Maya (People Ops): Yes — contractors with repo or infra access need to complete the training. Infra should upload: 1) access_review_<team>.csv, 2) 3 runbook excerpts showing oncall rotation, 3) evidence of recent patch/maintenance windows if in scope. Matrix: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/COMPLIANCE/Evidence+Matrix
Olivia (Legal): Quick note — any vendor contracts that are expiring Q2 need a redline before upload. If Legal is flagged, add a comment so we can prioritize review.
Noah (Platform): Uploaded access_review_platform.csv to the drive and left a comment with contractor list. Lmk if file format needs changing.
compliance-bot: Received upload "evidence-submissions/1719001234-noah-access.csv" from Noah (Platform).
Samir (Eng-Security): Thanks Noah. One more: what's the cutoff for controls testing artifacts? Do auditors need screenshots or exports?
Maya (People Ops): Auditors accept exports + screenshots. For access controls we prefer CSV exports and one screenshot of the admin console showing the group membership. Logs: 30 days export preferred. I'll post a short upload template in ~10m.
Noah (Platform): Got the template. Starting exports now.
Olivia (Legal): If anyone is using PII in test datasets, open a Security exception request and include a retention/erasure plan.
Maya (People Ops): Appreciate the quick turnaround. If you can't make Fri EOD, DM me so I can note it on the audit timeline. :heart:
Samir (Eng-Security): I'll cross-post a reminder in #eng-security.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks — cross-posted.
